name: Cipher Lab
tagline: Crack encodings the way attackers do. Learn what each one really is.

missions.title: Caesar Shift
missions.brief: Every letter was moved the same distance along the alphabet. Shift it back.

missions.title: Base64
missions.brief: This is an encoding, not a lock. Decode the word.

missions.title: Hex Bytes
missions.brief: Each pair of hex digits is one byte. Turn the bytes back into letters.

missions.title: Binary
missions.brief: Eight bits per letter. Read them like the machine does.
